name: Challenger 2
armament: 120 mm L30A1 rifled gun (CR2) / 120 mm L55A1 smoothbore (CR3)
protection: Dorchester (Chobham 2nd gen) composite; TES kit adds ERA and bar armour; CR3 adds new modular armour and APS. Game rule: immune to small-calibre; 7.62x54R and 12.7/14.5 mm only damage optics, tracks and exposed crew; penetrating the hull needs launchers (RPG-7 PG-7V, AT4, MAAWS, SMAW, NLAW, Javelin) or cannon.
visual_notes: Very flat, slab-sided angular turret with sloped front
6 road wheels per side, rear sprocket, side skirts
Long gun with thermal sleeve and fume extractor (CR2)
Commander's panoramic sight on turret roof
TES: bar armour on rear, add-on blocks on hull front and sides
